A reusable Go client for TS11 credential metadata registries -
[registry.siros.org](https://registry.siros.org) and any compatible
registry generated by
[registry-cli](https://github.com/sirosfoundation/registry-cli). Resolves
SD-JWT VC Type Metadata documents by their `vct` claim value, and
mdoc/MDDL metadata documents by their `doctype` value, replacing
per-service vendored/hardcoded credential metadata with a live (but
cache-first) lookup.

## Why

Issuers and verifiers in the SIROS ecosystem have historically vendored
SD-JWT VC Type Metadata and mdoc doctype schemas as local files. A TS11
registry publishes the same metadata centrally, but a client resolving
against it still needs: a mapping from `vct`/`doctype` to the registry's
actual document URL (not derivable from the `vct` value alone - it's
often an issuer-controlled identifier, not a URL on the registry's own
domain), support for more than one registry, and a cache so every
resolution isn't a live round-trip.

## Design

- **Multiple registries, queried concurrently, first hit wins.** Every
  `ResolveVCT`/`ResolveDoctype` call races all configured registries;
  whichever answers first (and has the entry) wins, and the rest are
  canceled. A slow or unreachable registry never blocks resolution as
  long as another configured registry has the answer.
- **Cache-first by default.** Each registry's discovery index
  (`.well-known/vctm-registry.json`) is fetched once and reused for every
  subsequent lookup; set `Config.RefreshInterval` to re-fetch
  periodically instead of relying on it forever.
- **Local overrides behave as permanently cached.** `LocalSource` wraps a
  fixed set of statically-configured documents that never expire and are
  never re-fetched - checked first, and always winning over any registry
  - so an existing local-file configuration keeps working unchanged when
  registries are introduced alongside it.
- **Callers own their own types.** `Resolved.Data` is the raw document
  bytes; this package doesn't impose a VCTM/MDDL struct of its own -
  decode into whatever type you already use.

## Usage

```go
import "github.com/sirosfoundation/go-ts11client"

local, _ := ts11client.NewLocalSource(
    ts11client.LocalEntry{VCT: "urn:eudi:pid:1", Data: pidVCTMBytes},
)

client, err := ts11client.New(ts11client.Config{
    Local: local, // always checked first, always wins
    Registries: []ts11client.RegistryConfig{
        {BaseURL: "https://registry.siros.org"},
        {BaseURL: "https://registry.example.org"},
    },
})

res, err := client.ResolveVCT(ctx, "https://issuer.example.com/credentials/ehic")
if err != nil {
    if errors.Is(err, ts11client.ErrNotFound) {
        // no local override or registry has this vct
    }
    return err
}
var meta MyVCTMType
json.Unmarshal(res.Data, &meta)
```
